title: EMMO: Early Modern Manuscripts Online
notes: EMMO is the Folger Shakespeare Library's IMLS-funded project giving web access to TEI P5 transcriptions, images and metadata of 16th- and 17th-century English manuscripts, with diplomatic/semi-diplomatic/regularized text flavors and a downloadable XML corpus; the site (live 200) documents exactly '100 transcribed documents'. Crowdsourced transcription ran on Dromio (transcribe.folger.edu); the IMLS grant concluded, leaving the site a preserved static resource. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Folger Shakespeare Library (project lead Heather Wolfe)
license_note: Each transcription page carries 'Terms of Use: Transcriptions are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License' (link to creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); this covers the transcriptions, not the images, which are served from the Folger's Luna repository.
